comment: The hash of the Manhattan preset's map SVG, as test/layout.test.ts renders it: a whole city with a borough in use and one packed up. The city builder's steps (docs/city-builder.md) must keep it until the drawing is meant to change. Step two set it: the station and the towers became two buildings, so the MetLife slab paints before the terminal (a pixel strip on its east wall, checked in the browser). The street lights along the avenues were spaced twice as far apart (one a cell, not two) on 2026-11-05, at the person's request: the only change to the map. On 2026-11-05 the buildings' faces were merged into one path per fill per layer (compose in src/draw/map.ts) for the frame rate: the same picture, checked in the browser against the previous build (only hairline antialiasing at shared edges differs, max 69/255 on 49 pixels at fit).
